fields.Name: T68 - Membership Member History
fields.Description: Verifies a Member record form renders with its related-records sections present.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Members' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Members', click the exact match), click a member row, then 'Open Full Record'. Verify the form displays the member's detail fields AND that the related-records section area is present — the Member has many related sections (Memberships, Enrollments, Certifications, Invoices, Event Registrations, etc.); scroll DOWN the form to confirm related-section headers are visible. SUCCESS = the member record form renders with detail fields and the related-records section area present (section headers visible). You do NOT need to expand a specific section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Member record full form is displayed with detail fields
The form's related-records section area is present (related-section headers visible on scroll)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
